sources.title: United Nations Treaty Series No. 476 — Afghanistan–USSR Frontier Agreement
sources.coverage: Frontier Agreement signed at Moscow on 13 June 1946, Protocol, exchange of notes and official entry-into-force chronology
sources.notes: UNTS No. 476 records entry into force on 17 January 1947. Article 1 fixes the Amu-Darya and navigable Pyandzh frontier by thalweg, with principal-fairway and median-line fallbacks; Article 2 orders a Mixed Commission to map Khamiab–Lake Sar-i-Kul and compile a detailed description and boundary-post record; the exchange of notes orders Zulfikar–Khamiab re-demarcation on the 1885–1888 Anglo-Russian documents and maps.

sources.title: United Nations Treaty Series No. 4655 — Treaty concerning the regime of the Soviet-Afghan State frontier
sources.coverage: 1958 Soviet-Afghan frontier-regime treaty, including authoritative identification of the 29 September 1948 demarcation/re-demarcation documents and continuity of the 1895 Pamir protocols
sources.notes: Article 1 states that Zulfikar–Lake Zor-Kul is determined by the 1946 Agreement and demarcation/re-demarcation documents dated 29 September 1948, with the re-demarcation based on the 1885–1888 protocol; Lake Zor-Kul–China is determined by the 1895 demarcation protocols. The treaty entered into force on 5 October 1958.
